notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard timestamped update-rate reduction and retraction. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies that reliable timestamped reflection remains delivered while an in-window best-effort passel is reduced by an active named update rate, and that its retraction lifecycle remains standard, without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped attribute update, update-rate, time-management, time-advance, and retraction services with FederateAmbassador discovery, time, reflection, and grant callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador timestamped update-rate reduction declarations
